description: This file defines an Android activity 'LoaderCursor' that demonstrates the use of a CursorLoader to asynchronously load and display contacts data in a fragment with search filtering capability.

classes.name: LoaderCursor
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating loading contacts with CursorLoader and managing a fragment.

classes.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment that displays contacts using a CursorLoader with search functionality.

classes.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment.MySearchView
classes.description: Custom SearchView subclass to clear query upon collapsing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the list fragment if not already present.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Prepares the list adapter, initializes the loader, and sets up the search view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with a search item.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the search query, triggers loader restart with new filter.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles query submission, but in this case, it does nothing special.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Clears the search query when the search view is closed.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader for contacts, filtering if needed.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Swaps in the new cursor data once loading is complete.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Resets the adapter cursor when loader is reset.
